entries.target: Work Item planning ladder: scan -> rri -> vision -> blueprint -> contracts -> task_graph durable stages with per-stage owner artifact checkpoints
entries.reason: Superseded by lean flow (/apm start complexity routing -> .apm flat-file artifacts -> import-apm). Last planning artifact 2026-09-08; zero planning-stage artifacts and zero Work Item events since; all commits from 2026-09-09 are lean-flow work.
entries.expected_escape: A post-cutover work item needs a planning artifact that only the ladder produced (reviewer rejection citing missing blueprint/contracts/scan evidence), or an agent session attempts task_manager planning actions for new work.
entries.window: 10 imported work items or 30 days, whichever first

entries.target: task_manager planning actions: checkpoint_rri_interview, load_rri_interview, save_rri_interview, save_blueprint_draft, load_blueprint_draft, review_blueprint_checkpoint, approve_blueprint_draft, save_work_item_artifact (planning stages), approve_work_item_artifact, load_planning_artifact, reject_work_item_scan, amend_work_item_planning, reset_work_item_planning, validate_work_item_graph, materialize_work_item
entries.reason: Tool surface of the retired planning ladder (DEL-0001). Retained but documented as legacy in docs/lean-flow.md; agents are instructed not to start new work through them.
entries.expected_escape: An agent attempts one of these actions post-cutover and no documented lean-flow replacement covers its need; or imported work items lack a required input the action used to supply.

entries.target: Relic tables in per-project tasks.db: task_items, tasks, task_materializations, task_phase_metadata, epic_events, task_events, pipeline_runs (pre-Work-Item model)
entries.reason: Pre-Work-Item model history. Kept read-only as migration/audit history (AGENTS.md: archived rows are read-only migration history). Drop is irreversible, so this entry only authorizes removal after a quiet window.
entries.expected_escape: Any recovery, audit, or reporting scenario requires pre-Work-Item task history; or a code path still reads these tables in production.
entries.window: 90 days of zero reads plus one successful backup-restore drill without them
